raw_sections.Description:
The HP Victus 15 15-fa2082wm Gaming Laptop features an Intel® Core™ i5-13420H (13th Gen) processor with 8 cores (4 Performance + 4 Efficient), 12 threads and a maximum turbo frequency of Up to 4.6 GHz. It combines 16 GB DDR4 memory with DDR4-3200 MHz memory type and a 512 GB PCIe® NVMe™ M.2 SSD for storage. Graphics are provided by the NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 4050 Laptop GPU with 6 GB GDDR6 dedicated VRAM, alongside Intel® UHD Graphics. The laptop has a 15.6 inches FHD IPS, Anti-glare display with 1920 × 1080 resolution and a 144 Hz refresh rate. Connectivity includes Wi-Fi 6 + Bluetooth® 5.3 and an RJ-45 LAN port, while the operating system is Windows 11 Home. Finished in Mica Silver, this HP Victus 15 gaming laptop is available through Compumarts for buyers in Egypt.
